description: This file defines utility classes for serial execution of asynchronous functions within the Orleans framework. It includes a generic executor class 'AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult>' for executing ranked asynchronous tasks serially, and a non-generic 'AsyncSerialExecutor' class that wraps the generic class for void-returning tasks. The classes utilize concurrent queues and interlocked locking mechanisms to ensure serialized execution of async functions, which can be used especially within reentrant grain code to prevent reentrancy issues.

classes.name: AsyncSerialExecutor<TResult>
classes.description: A utility class that provides serial execution of async functions of type TResult, ensuring that submitted asynchronous tasks execute in order without interleaving.

classes.name: AsyncSerialExecutor
classes.description: A wrapper class that provides serial execution for async functions returning void by internally using the generic AsyncSerialExecutor<bool>.

classes.name: InterlockedExchangeLock
classes.description: A private nested class that implements a lock mechanism using Interlocked.Exchange to acquire and release locks.

methods.name: AddNext
methods.description: Submits a function to be executed serially, returning a task that completes when the function has finished execution.

methods.name: ExecuteNext
methods.description: Internal method to process the queued actions, ensuring they execute one at a time using a lock.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: A helper static method that wraps a Task-returning function and returns a boolean indicating completion.
